_read_me: Commands that fail on huginn but not in CI, so ci-touched.mjs prints KNOWN for them and does not fail the run. One entry per command; workflow is the file name, job is the job id, command is the run text exactly as the workflow has it. Keep this short: an entry is a debt. When a listed command passes, ci-touched.mjs says so; delete the entry then.

known.reason: sheet-spec renders 7,813 px tall on huginn because the alpha and approx glyphs fall back to another font; the other baselines match (TG-63)
